payload.text: ISSUE:0688, no_daemon_required.sh's unbounded inside-the-project guard, is fixed on vc's ruling as its own unit, canon's copy in intent/.canon/st/ST0057.json included, drafted in tmp/wt-dc-0688 and banked unproved.
